commandNotes-windows.ux2dos: Linux-only utility; not available on Windows Server. Replace with PowerShell or a DOS equivalent.
commandNotes-windows.mailx: Linux mail client; not available on Windows Server. Use Send-MailMessage (PowerShell) or a Windows SMTP library.
commandNotes-windows.chmod: Linux permission command; not applicable on Windows Server NTFS. Remove or replace with icacls.
commandNotes-windows.rm: Linux file removal; replace with del or Remove-Item on Windows Server.
commandNotes-windows.mv: Linux move/rename command; replace with move or Rename-Item on Windows Server.
commandNotes-windows.cp: Linux copy command; replace with copy or Copy-Item on Windows Server.
commandNotes-windows.ls: Linux directory listing; replace with dir or Get-ChildItem on Windows Server.
commandNotes-windows.grep: Linux pattern search; replace with Select-String (PowerShell) or findstr on Windows Server.
commandNotes-windows.sed: Linux stream editor; replace with PowerShell -replace operator on Windows Server.
commandNotes-windows.awk: Linux text processing; replace with PowerShell one-liners or install via Git Bash/WSL.
commandNotes-windows.curl: Available on modern Windows Server 2019+; verify version and TLS compatibility.
commandNotes-windows.wget: Not available by default; use Invoke-WebRequest (PowerShell) or install explicitly.
commandNotes-windows.ftp: Legacy FTP client; consider WinSCP scripting or BITS for production use.
commandNotes-windows.ssh: Available on Windows Server 2019+ as optional feature. Verify installation.
commandNotes-windows.scp: Available on Windows Server 2019+ via OpenSSH optional feature.
commandNotes-windows.tar: Available on Windows Server 2019+. Verify version and flag compatibility.
commandNotes-windows.find: Linux find differs from Windows find/findstr — use Get-ChildItem -Recurse.
commandNotes-windows.pform3: Site-specific PFORM binary; verify Windows build deployed and $PFORM set.
commandNotes-windows.pform: Site-specific PFORM binary; verify Windows build deployed and $PFORM set.

commandNotes-windows.fx: Custom fax transmission utility; verify Windows build deployed.
commandNotes-windows.dos2unix: Available via Git for Windows or GNU utilities for Windows.
